# Finishing details (FD)

This is the short form. Before writing code in this area, read the full rules with reasons, bad/good examples and checks: `.ui-polish/rules/13-finishing-details.md`.

- **FD-01 Favicon and app icons** (warning). Provide a favicon set: `favicon.ico` (32px) and an SVG icon (which can adapt to dark mode with a media query inside the SVG), a 180px `apple-touch-icon.png`, and a web manifest with 192 and 512px icons if the app is installable. Derive it from the brand mark in `design.md`; if there is no logo, use the product initial on the primary colour. Remove the framework's default icon.
- **FD-02 Title and description on every page** (error). Each page has a unique `<title>` in the form "Page name · Product" (50 to 60 characters, most specific part first) and a `<meta name="description">` of one or two sentences (up to about 155 characters) that says what the page offers. In Next.js export `metadata` with `title: { default, template: '%s · Product' }` in the root layout and a title per route. Replace every scaffold default.
- **FD-03 Social preview tags and image** (warning). Add Open Graph and Twitter tags: `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image` (1200×630 PNG or JPG, under about 300 KB, absolute URL, with `og:image:alt`), `og:url`, `og:type`, `twitter:card="summary_large_image"`. The image shows the product name and a one-line value statement in the brand type and colours, readable at thumbnail size. Set `<link rel="canonical">` and `theme-color`.
- **FD-04 Images reserve their space** (warning). Every `<img>` has `width` and `height` attributes matching its intrinsic ratio (CSS can still resize it), or sits in a box with `aspect-ratio`. Use `object-fit: cover` for crops, `loading="lazy"` and `decoding="async"` below the fold, `fetchpriority="high"` on the main hero image, and modern formats at the displayed size (not a 4000px photo in a 300px slot). Avatars and thumbnails have a fallback (initials on `--muted`) for missing or broken images.
- **FD-05 A designed 404 page** (info). Provide a not-found page (`404.html`, `app/not-found.tsx`, or the framework equivalent) that keeps the site header and navigation, says plainly that the page does not exist, and offers a way forward: a link home, search, or the most likely destinations. Match the product's tone; no stack traces, no stock illustration of a lost astronaut.
- **FD-06 Error pages and boundaries** (warning). Add an error boundary at the app root and around independent regions (`error.tsx` per route segment in Next.js), plus styled 500 and offline states. The fallback keeps navigation, explains in plain language that something failed on our side, offers "Try again" (re-render) and a way out, and logs the technical detail instead of showing it.
- **FD-07 Toasts are placed, timed and stacked** (warning). Use one toast system (`Toaster` recipe, sonner) mounted once. Position bottom-right on desktop and top-centre or bottom-centre on phones, clear of fixed bars. Success and info dismiss after 4 to 6 seconds and pause on hover and focus; errors and toasts with actions stay until dismissed. Stack at most three. Each toast is one short sentence, optionally with one action (Undo, View). Toasts are for transient confirmation: never for form validation, never for anything the user must read to proceed.
- **FD-08 Modals and overlays behave** (error). Use the `Dialog` recipe. A modal has a title (`DialogTitle`, required for the accessible name), a close button, closes on Escape and backdrop click (except when it would lose unsaved input), traps focus, locks background scroll without shifting the page (`scrollbar-gutter: stable`), and returns focus on close. Width is `min(100% - 2rem, 32rem)` by default; height is capped at `100dvh - 2rem` with the body scrolling and the header and footer fixed. The scrim uses the `--overlay` token. On phones, tall dialogs become bottom sheets. Never stack modal on modal; never open a modal on page load.
- **FD-09 Layers follow the z-index scale** (warning). Stack order, low to high: content, sticky headers (`--z-sticky`), dropdowns anchored in content (`--z-dropdown`), overlay scrims (`--z-overlay`), modals (`--z-modal`), popovers and selects opened from inside modals (`--z-popover`), toasts (`--z-toast`), tooltips (`--z-tooltip`). Render overlays in a portal at the end of `<body>`. Give self-contained components `isolation: isolate` so their internal `z-index: 1` cannot leak.
- **FD-10 No layout shift** (warning). Reserve space for everything that arrives late: images and embeds (FD-04), web fonts (metric-matched fallback, TY-03), async content (skeletons with final dimensions, ST-02), banners and cookie notices (overlay or reserved slot, not inserted above content), and client-only widgets (fixed-size placeholder). Keep cumulative layout shift under 0.1.
- **FD-11 Content resilience: long, short, many, none** (warning). Test every component with hostile content: a 60-character name with no spaces, a three-letter name, zero items, one item, 500 items, a missing image, a negative number, a right-to-left string. Single-line labels truncate with an ellipsis and expose the full text in a `Tooltip`; multi-line text clamps with `line-clamp-*`; flex children have `min-w-0`; long lists paginate or virtualise; counts handle singular and plural.
